name: Clash
doc: Clash (X-ATM092's enemy attack): one emitter per target - bursts of rings and sparks at the caster's bones, two shock waves, dust, a screen flash, the target knocked back (thrown up, spinning, landing with a ring and sparks, walking back), the result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag026_clash.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per target: its sound, the shock waves, the knock-back, the dust, the screen flash

parts.title: Bursts
parts.doc: Rings and sparks at the caster's bones (target 0's emitter)

groups.label: Bursts
groups.doc: Ticks: First and Last (bones 0x34, 0x35, 0x36, 0x33 with rings), A (bone 0x36), B (bone 0x34); sparks each, their radius

params.label: Start tick
params.doc: The shock waves, the knock-back, the dust and the flash from this tick

params.label: Knock-back gravity
params.doc: Added to the target's upward speed a tick

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Dust
params.doc: The sprite sequence dust (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 32 vertices, 16 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Wave a model
params.doc: The prim model wave a (a mesh of 48 vertices, 32 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Wave b model
params.doc: The prim model wave b (a mesh of 33 vertices, 32 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))
